items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Tenshill plays a type of music, what you call a ballyhorn. It plays a lot of bass music.

ctx.x: Yeah. I never saw many of those. I saw a few of them. But what kind of music would they play on a Tenshill? Roachill.
Tenshill plays a type of music, what you call a ballyhorn. It plays a lot of bass music.
Would there be popular songs with jazz or would there be brass bands?
